engine: unchanged SVH-R V2; no C1/C2 repair
scratch: transient zero-only K/V scratch retained and real overhead included in timing; not persistent visual KV
CPU_input_cache: all selected images prepared before model loading; CPU BF16 tensors on ext4 SSD

stage_A_selection.selected: top three reaccess candidates plus R0
stage_A_selection.ties: higher Query, lower measured KV capacity, fewer layers, frozen candidate order
stage_A_selection.anomaly: any meta/repetition/empty/truncation/explanation flag; all included in scoring

stage_B_selection.best_quality: highest Query accuracy; ties lower actual KV capacity, fewer layers, frozen order
stage_B_selection.best_efficiency: within 2.5pp of highest Query and NonQuery no worse than R0-2.5pp; minimize number of layers, then actual KV capacity; if no eligible candidate use R0
stage_B_selection.measured_KV_cost: arithmetic mean of actual quality-EOS cache capacity; output lengths differ and are recorded; fixed32 KV measured separately

smoke_hard_gates.severe_output: per condition >=3 of 8 meta/empty/repetitive outputs stops
smoke_hard_gates.widespread_disagreement: per condition >=4 of 8 parsed-answer disagreements Dense vs Physical stops
smoke_hard_gates.known_BF16_logit_error: record only; no old MaxAbs gate
smoke_hard_gates.multitoken_coverage: at least one observed valid multi-token answer; otherwise pause, do not add outcome-selected samples

quality_stop_policy.systematic_output: two consecutive nonoverlapping 32-request windows within a condition each have meta>=25% or empty/repeat>=12.5% or truncation>=50%; OR ten consecutive empty/repetitive outputs. Individual anomalies always retained and scored

bootstrap.multiplicity: ordinary unadjusted exploratory intervals; selection and many subgroups prevent confirmatory claims

speed.boundary: GPU-ready input through Vision/projector/prefill/decode and method cleanup; synchronized wall time; no disk/tokenizer/H2D/results writing; unmodified frozen engine
